_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::mixture#3. The volumetric locking is real: on the upstream mixture cube (mixture_elast_hyper_dynamic.4C.yaml, fixed at z=0 with a surface traction on top) raising the neo-Hookean Poisson ratio to 0.4999 with plain displacement-based HEX8 collapses the node-17 z displacement, while the same mesh with TECH fbar on the element line keeps it in the compressible range — a ratio of more than an order of magnitude, which the fixture computes from the two logs and asserts. What is wrong in the entry is the remedy: 4C's cure here is an element technology on the element line (TECH fbar), not a mixed (u,p) or augmented-Lagrangian formulation of the mixture material. The measured ratio stays in this fixture and is deliberately kept out of the knowledge text. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the compressible Poisson ratio, so neither arm is near-incompressible. Nothing locks, the ratio collapses to about 1 and the verdict flips to no, so the fixture must go red.
remove the cure instead: leave the FBAR arm on plain displacement elements. The two arms become identical, the ratio is 1 and the verdict flips to no, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/MAT 1 KINEM nonlinear"/MAT 1 KINEM nonlinear TECH fbar"/' "$TMP/locked.yaml" > "$TMP/fbar.yaml"
